citation.title: Clinical performance of implant-assisted removable partial dentures using implant surveyed crowns: a systematic review and meta-analysis
citation.authors: So-Yeun Kim, Young-Eun Cho, Seoung-Jin Hong, Jung-Bo Huh, Se-Wook Pyo, Yuseung Yi, Soo-Yeon Yoo

s_design.anchor: Systematic review of retrospective studies and case reports, self-described as a meta-analysis with no pooling performed (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: Therefore, this systematic review and meta-analysis

domains.note: Absence. Read the Introduction, the Materials and Methods (PRISMA statement, PICO, search, eligibility, data extraction) and the funding line. No protocol, PROSPERO or registration number appears anywhere. Searched for the wording register/registration/protocol/PROSPERO.

domains.evidence_quote: PubMed, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Korea
domains.note: Three bibliographic databases are searched: MEDLINE/PubMed counted as one, Cochrane, Web of Science and KCI. The full Boolean string is reported in Table 1, and reference lists were hand-searched.

domains.evidence_quote: A total of 214 articles were obtained. After checking
domains.note: There is no per-study list of excluded full texts. The review does report (a) a screening account with counts (214 obtained, exclusions by reason, 84 abstracts evaluated, 31 eligible, Fig. 1 flowchart) and (b) explicit inclusion criteria.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: Absence, and the text says so directly. Materials and Methods states that quality assessments were not undertaken ('no quality assessments were undertak-en'), justified by citing scoping-review convention. No appraisal tool is named and no quality or bias appraisal appears in Methods, Results, Discussion or the tables.

Absence. Despite the title, Methods describes no pooling: no statistical model, no effect measure, no heterogeneity test and no software. Results and tables report each study's figures narratively. Searched for pooled/random/fixed effect/heterogeneity/forest/I2 and found none.
Absence. Read Methods, Results and Discussion. There is no funnel plot, no Egger or Begg test and no publication or small-study bias wording anywhere.

penalties.note: There is no conflict-of-interest declaration anywhere in the text. Checked the first-page footer, the funding line, the end of the Conclusion and the block before References, and looked for ligature variants. The funder is named (partial support of the Korean Academy of Prosthodontics), but it is an academic society, not a manufacturer. The row fires only on the missing CoI statement.
Applies to RCTs only; this is a systematic review.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome requires
penalties.note: The Conclusion claims ICRPD is 'expected to be effective as a long-term treatment strategy' on survival/success grounds. However, the 100% survival figures it reports rest on implants observed for at least one year, and Table 2 records an included study concluding that evidence is inadequate to ensure long-term prognosis. This is not covered by any Q_method domain.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۱۹ از ۱۰۰ است و برای پرسش THERAPY در باند E (سطح پس‌زمینه و نظر) قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور چهار پایگاه داده را جستجو کرده، اما ثبت پروتکلی گزارش نکرده، کیفیت مطالعات واردشده را ارزیابی نکرده و با وجود عنوان، هیچ meta-analysis واقعی انجام نداده است. داده‌ها از نه مطالعه‌ی retrospective و تعدادی case report کره‌ای می‌آیند. نرخ بقای ۹۵ تا ۱۰۰ درصد ICRPD نشانه‌ای امیدوارکننده ولی کوتاه‌مدت است، نه شاهدی محکم برای اثربخشی بلندمدت.
